name: Gorgippus
role: King of the Bosporan Kingdom, joint ruler with his brother Leucon
contribution: A son of Satyrus I and was a Spartocid joint ruler with his brother Leucon of the Bosporan Kingdom.

checks.lead: Gorgippus (Ancient Greek: Γοργιππος, romanized: Gorgippos) was a son of Satyrus I and was a Spartocid joint ruler with his brother Leucon (389–349 BCE) of the Bosporan Kingdom. He situated himself on the Asiatic side of the kingdom, in Gorgippia where he ruled until, presumably, his death in 349 BCE.
